verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no published per-signal pricing page or documentation enabling cost prediction without sales contact; instead, community reports explicitly cite 'Lack of billing transparency' as a reason for leaving Datadog and describe pricing as requiring negotiated/account-manager-adjusted rates rather than transparent self-serve figures. Missing for 10: any docs citation of a public pricing/cost calculator page, per-signal unit pricing tables, or evidence that costs can be estimated without sales engagement.
